description: Get graded results for finished events from official sources: the score, which outcomes won in the main markets (head to head, line and total), voids and dead heats, and whether every market has settled. Give an event_id for one game (with every graded market), or a league_id for recent games. Costs 1 credit for one event, 2 for a league window.

days_back.description: With league_id: events that started in this many past days. Default 3.

event_id.description: One event's result, by its event ID from find_event

league_id.description: Results for one league, for example nba, nfl, afl or nrl

name: get_results
title: Results
